title: The open repository clones and deploys with no billing configured

comments.author: home
comments.text:
As someone evaluating Chatticus, I want to clone AnthusAI/Chattic.us and deploy
it with no billing system configured, so that the open product is genuinely
self-contained.

**Blocked by:** nothing directly, but must hold true after every other story in
this epic lands. **Unblocks:** nothing; this is a guard.

---
Feature: The open repository has no billing dependency

  Scenario: A fresh clone deploys with no Stripe configuration
    Given a fresh clone of AnthusAI/Chattic.us with no Stripe keys or secrets set
    When the CDK stacks are synthesized and deployed
    Then the deploy succeeds
    And no code path references Stripe, an Account, or payment state

  Scenario: The organization lifecycle needs no billing signal
    Given a freshly deployed instance
    When an operator enables an organization through the members CLI
    Then the organization becomes enabled with no billing system involved

**Done when:** grep for "stripe" (case-insensitive) across the repository
returns nothing outside private-repo references in docs/comments.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Naming note: this scenario's "clone AnthusAI/Chattic.us" refers to the open
product repository, which chatticus-6b0d8b renames to AnthusAI/Chatticus
(no dot) — distinct from AnthusAI/Chattic.us-web, the private marketing/SaaS
repo (with the dot, after the domain). Sequence-independent: the guarantee
this story specifies (no billing in the open repo) holds under either name.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Verified: grep -rli stripe across the whole repo (excluding project/issues, which records intent, not code) returns nothing. The organization enable path remains the members CLI only -- the operator HTTP API (chatticus-16d3a9) that would let a private SaaS layer call it is separately scheduled under the Stripe epic chatticus-e26358, not built here, so there is no billing-adjacent code path in this repo at all yet.
